description.value: The Village Idiot Bar & Grill is a casual, après-themed restaurant and bar in the heart of Revelstoke, widely regarded as a local favourite and known globally for its made-to-order pizzas. The menu spans burgers, poutine, mussels, and signature cocktails, with an emphasis on housemade sauces, soups, and dressings. The patio and relaxed atmosphere make it a natural stop for visitors winding down after a day on the road or trails.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business as a full-service bar and grill at 306 Mackenzie Avenue, Revelstoke, with matching phone number, operating 7 days a week. The menu explicitly labels vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free items, and the About page states 'a large variety of quality gluten and dairy free items to choose from.' No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Delivery noted as 'temporarily closed' on the website — minor uncertainty about current operational scope, but core dine-in service appears active.
Bike parking and washroom availability not mentioned on website or in OSM tags; field verification recommended before publishing those amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, actively operating bar and grill in central Revelstoke open 7 days a week, with a diverse menu including gluten-free and vegan options — a solid food and drink stop for touring cyclists passing through town.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu items explicitly labelled (Veg), (Vegan), and (GF) throughout; About page states 'a large variety of quality gluten and dairy free items to choose from.'
